ns2:section.sectionText: Critical Race Feminism. This course will focus on critical race feminism and the status of women of color under the law. It will address the role of the law in addressing and responding to the unique challenges affecting women of color, While a significant portion of the course will focus on the experiences of African-American women, the experiences of White women, Latinas, Asian-American women, and Native American women will also be examined. It will explore the intersection of race and gender status from an interdisciplinary legal and sociological perspective. It will be an interdisciplinary course, including the disciplines of Black Studies, film, history, sociology, and law.
